verified_facts.text: The resort sits in front of a secluded beach.
verified_facts.excerpt: spend a golden afternoon on the secluded beach in front of our hotel,

verified_facts.text: Some rooms overlook the resort's private lagoon, where guests can watch dolphins play.
verified_facts.excerpt: Watch dolphins play in the resort’s private lagoon from the comfort of our newly refreshed room.

verified_facts.text: The resort's dolphin experiences are run with its partner, Dolphin Quest.
verified_facts.excerpt: Learn more about our partner, Dolphin Quest.

verified_facts.text: Rooms come with a choice of golf mountain, dolphin lagoon or full ocean views.
verified_facts.excerpt: a choice of golf mountain, dolphin lagoon, and full ocean views

verified_facts.text: Golf Mountain View Lanai rooms look out over the Ko'olau Mountains and the neighboring Waialae Golf Course from a private balcony.
verified_facts.excerpt: panoramic views of the Koʻolau Mountains and the neighboring Waialae Golf Course from your private balcony

verified_facts.text: The Imperial Penthouse was enjoyed by Emperor Akihito and renamed after his stay.
verified_facts.excerpt: Renamed the Imperial Penthouse, this unique penthouse was enjoyed by Emperor Akihito himself.

verified_facts.text: The Kahala Beach Suite has a wrap-around lanai just steps from the shore.
verified_facts.excerpt: With a wrap-around lanai just steps from the shore

verified_facts.text: The Partial Ocean View Suite is a corner suite with views of the Pacific, the Ko'olau range, Koko Head Crater and Waialae Country Club.
verified_facts.excerpt: the Pacific Ocean, Ko'olau mountain range, the famed Koko Head Crater, and the lush green of Waialae Country Club in this unique corner suite

verified_facts.text: Alan Wong's serves Hawaii Regional Cuisine drawing on the ethnic influences found in Hawaii, with locally farmed ingredients and local fish.
verified_facts.excerpt: A cooking style that borrows from all the ethnic influences found in Hawaii using freshly farmed ingredients from the land and fish from our seas.

verified_facts.text: Alan Wong's dinner dress code is evening resort wear, dress shorts or Aloha wear with shoes or dress sandals.
verified_facts.excerpt: Evening resort wear, dress shorts, Aloha wear, shoes or dress sandals are appropriate.

verified_facts.text: Plumeria Beach House offers beachfront open-air seating with an ocean view.
verified_facts.excerpt: Dine at the relaxing beach front open-air seating with exclusive ocean view and soft Hawaiian sea breeze.

verified_facts.text: The Veranda is a lounge serving cocktails and evening appetizers under the resort's chandelier.
verified_facts.excerpt: Unwind and relax under our iconic chandelier. Serving cocktails and evening appetizers

verified_facts.text: Seaside Grill has a poolside bar serving handcrafted cocktails and casual bites by the beach.
verified_facts.excerpt: sip on handcrafted cocktails at the poolside bar, and enjoy casual bites by the beach

verified_facts.text: Arancino at the resort serves classic yet innovative Italian cuisine.
verified_facts.excerpt: Known for its classic yet innovative Italian cuisine, Arancino serves delicious creations that tantalize all of your senses.

verified_facts.text: Kaffe Kahala, on the lobby level along the Wall of Fame, serves Illy coffee, artisanal pastries and gourmet sandwiches.
verified_facts.excerpt: premium Illy coffee, artisanal pastries, and gourmet sandwiches. Located on the lobby level along the Wall of Fame

verified_facts.text: The resort charges no resort fee.
verified_facts.excerpt: Complimentary To All Our Guest Rooms & Suites (No Resort Fee)

verified_facts.text: Hawaiian cultural classes such as hula dancing, lei making and lauhala weaving are complimentary for guests.
verified_facts.excerpt: Hawaiian cultural classes (Hula Dancing, Lei Making and Lauhala Weaving etc.)

verified_facts.text: A complimentary shuttle bus runs to Kahala Mall, Waikiki and Ala Moana.
verified_facts.excerpt: Shuttle bus service to Kahala Mall, Waikiki and Ala Moana

verified_facts.text: Guests have 24-hour access to the CHI Health & Fitness Center, including a steam room and hot tub.
verified_facts.excerpt: 24 hr access to CHI Health & Fitness Center, including steam room and hot tub

verified_facts.text: All rooms and suites have TOTO washlets.
verified_facts.excerpt: TOTO washlets in all rooms & suites

verified_facts.text: Under the Kahala Family Plan, children aged 17 and under stay with their parents at no extra cost.
verified_facts.excerpt: children aged 17 and under can stay with their parents at no extra cost

verified_facts.text: The resort partners with Aloha Sitters to offer child-sitting services.
verified_facts.excerpt: We are proud to partner with Aloha Sitters to offer child-sitting services

verified_facts.text: The resort's dog program accepts dogs under 25 pounds.
verified_facts.excerpt: dogs must be under 25lbs

verified_facts.text: KISCA, the resort's sustainability, culture and arts program, presents complimentary daily offerings such as lei making.
verified_facts.excerpt: complimentary daily offerings, thoughtfully presented by KISCA (Kahala Sustainability, Culture and the Arts)
